The minimum number of pieces is m + n − gcd(m, n) for m apples and n students.

Here 221 = 13·17 and 403 = 13·31, so gcd = 13.

The total of 221 + 403 − 13 = 611 can be checked by splitting into 13 identical groups of 17 apples for 31 students. Each group is connected, so it needs 17 + 31 − 1 = 47 pieces, and 13 · 47 = 611.

ANSWER: 611
